components.description: Native labeled schedule field; the app navigates immediately on selection. Theme uses the same control treatment but changes appearance in place.

components.name: Theme Picker
components.description: Page-header native Theme selector, available even without a snapshot. System follows live OS changes; explicit Light/Dark overrides the OS and persists under seances.theme when localStorage is available. Early classic js/theme.js applies stylesheet media, native color scheme, and browser chrome before paint and syncs on DOM ready/hydration. Blocked storage retains the in-page choice; without JS the stylesheet media query follows the OS. This preview demonstrates styling only, not persistence or switching.

components.name: Pane Scrollbar
components.description: Shared calendar/details scrollbar: thin standards styling and stable gutters; Chromium/Safari use a 10px gutter, 2px transparent thumb border (6px visible), 999px rounding, no painted background behind the thumb (transparent base scrollbar, track pieces, track, and corner), no arrows, and radius-section track margins (24px at the default root size). Accent hover; forced colors use native standard colors and CanvasText/Highlight WebKit thumbs. Live paired scrollbar-thumb tokens come from app.css and themes/dark.css.
components.html: Scroll to see more times and rooms.

components.name: Service Date Navigation

components.description: Non-interactive compact metadata, not a clickable filter.

components.name: Selected Timeline Screening
components.description: Opaque accent selection with directional Action Sheen, reflected edges, static glow, SVG check, and independently inset focus; unselected cards use Control Sheen, bevels, and card-shadow above inset lanes, while related screenings use a dashed soft-filled boundary instead. No noise or texture. Preference fallbacks retain solid selection and focus without decoration.

components.name: IMDb Film Link
components.description: Outlined external link with a tightly bounded fixed brand badge; the surrounding action remains in the mineral/teal system.
components.html: IMDbView on IMDb

components.name: Glass Schedule and Details
components.description: Tangible relief without noise or texture or an outer schedule card: headings and filters sit on the canvas, while calendar and details are separate glossy surfaces. Opaque inset lanes, independent alternating room-rail backgrounds, and a raised sticky 4rem time ruler strengthen wayfinding. The schedule ancestor is never filtered; no mobile filter override is needed. Unsupported blur keeps solid bases; final preference rules remove blur, gradients, and shadows but preserve rail contrast, ticks, borders, selection checks, and focus. Posters and raster assets are unchanged.

narrative.overview:
Séances is a clear, task-focused schedule reader. Mineral surfaces, strong control borders, teal active states, and open sans-serif typography help visitors scan cinema, service date, room, and start time without decorative cinema-poster treatment.

This approved system replaces the cream, burgundy, and serif identity while preserving the existing workspace. Appearance defaults to the device preference and offers a persistent Theme choice of System, Light, or Dark: pale mineral and white in light mode; layered dark slate, pale text, and mint-teal in dark mode. Selection links a screening to its details without confusing selection with keyboard focus.

The OpenCode Desktop reference and the request for Apple Liquid Glass-like gloss inform the surface treatment, not a new identity: paired canvas glows, directional highlights, beveled edges, and cast shadows give the interface tangible relief while retaining teal and device themes. No noise or texture is used. Stronger lanes, a raised room rail, and a substantial time ruler make room and start time easier to scan. Headings and filters sit directly on the canvas; calendar and details are individual glossy surfaces, without a surrounding card. Opaque fallbacks preserve reading surfaces when blur is unsupported or transparency or contrast preferences require them.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral surfaces and teal emphasis, coordinated across light and dark modes with explicit control and live device alignment in System mode.
Source Sans 3 throughout the interface, with an isolated IMDb brand badge exception.
Individual rounded glass calendar and details surfaces, inset timeline lanes, raised room/time headings, glossy rounded controls, and a chronological phone list.
Check-marked selection, dashed same-film treatment, and independently visible focus.

rules.name: The Paired Appearance Rule
rules.body: Change each semantic role together with its dark counterpart and its foreground; never apply the light palette unchanged to dark surfaces.

rules.name: The One Reading Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Source Sans 3 for interface headings and content; the IMDb badge is a bounded brand exception, not permission to introduce another display family.

rules.name: The Bounded Glass Rule
rules.body: Confine blurred glass shells and panel shadows to calendar and details, with no outer schedule card; create relief through directional highlights, cast shadows, and beveled edges, never noise or texture. Keep selection glow on selected desktop cards and booking only; preserve opaque reading bases, solid preference fallbacks, contrasting room rails, ruler ticks, mobile drawer positioning, borders, visible focus, selection checks, and dashed same-film cues.

dos: **Do** maintain paired mineral/teal light and dark roles, persist explicit Theme choices when storage is available, and follow live device changes in System mode.
**Do** preserve labels, inline SVG selection checks, dashed same-film cues, and independent visible keyboard focus.
**Do** preserve the wide timeline, narrow chronological list, and the smallest date-toolbar wrapping rule.
**Do** keep Source Sans 3 as the interface voice and IMDb styling confined to its brand badge.
donts: **Don't** add noise or texture; relief comes from directional highlights, cast shadows, and beveled edges.
**Don't** reintroduce cream/burgundy surfaces or the unused serif face as the current identity.
**Don't** replace selection, focus, or same-film distinctions with color alone.
**Don't** infer full WCAG conformance from axe results, contrast tests, or this document.
**Don't** restore the outer schedule card, blur its ancestor, add animated glow, bypass solid preference fallbacks, or change snapshot data or poster assets as part of documenting the system.
